light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Para adentro, en un cuarto, yo no le pongo cemento. Uso la receta de la guía: cal sola, sal y agua.
clips.action: he walks into a small bedroom with a bare grey plastered wall and puts a bucket down.

clips.text: Una jarra de cal por dos o tres de agua, hasta leche fina. La misma idea, sin el cemento.
clips.action: he pours milky limewash from a jug into a small bucket.

clips.text: Adentro no la lava la lluvia, y la cal sola respira mejor. Es muy buena en cuartos donde se junta humedad.
clips.action: he paints the bare interior wall with wide crossing strokes.

clips.text: Adentro, pinta con la ventana abierta, y ten a los niños y a las mascotas lejos del balde mientras trabajas.
clips.action: he opens the bedroom window wide, then turns back to the camera.

clips.text: Además, la cal es alcalina. Al moho no le gusta nada. Por eso se usaba en cocinas, baños y establos.
clips.action: he points at a corner of the ceiling with a small dark mould stain.

clips.text: Ahora, los límites, porque no todo es perfecto. Recién pintada, si la frotas, puede soltar un poquito de polvo.
clips.action: he touches the painted wall with a finger and shows it, honest face.

clips.text: Cuando cura bien, eso casi desaparece. Pero una cal mal hecha, sin mojar la pared, con los años suelta polvo al frotarla.
clips.action: he rubs a dry older section of the wall and shows a clean finger.

clips.text: Y no es pintura lavable. Una mancha de grasa no se va con trapo y jabón: se retoca con otra mano de cal, que para eso es barata.
clips.action: he shakes his head and wags his finger lightly.

clips.text: Y cuesta una fracción de una lata de pintura. Por eso, si se ensucia, no duele volver a pasarle.
clips.action: he picks up the bucket and walks toward the door.

clips.text: Ah, una cosa. Hay una variante de esto que funciona todavía mejor en paredes que se mojan mucho con la lluvia.
clips.action: he stops at the door and raises a finger, remembering.

clips.text: Te dejé exactamente cómo hacerla en la descripción.
clips.action: he points down toward the bottom of the frame with a knowing smile.
